messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Drinking alcohol in large amounts or regularly raises the risk of lactic acidosis.
Contrast dye used in imaging tests like CT scans can temporarily affect kidney function.
This can let metformin build up in your body.
Your doctor may have you stop taking metformin around the time of the test.
Your doctor may have you restart metformin once your kidney function is confirmed to be back to normal.
Triplet: ["contrast dye", "temporarily affects", "kidney function"]

The relation 'temporarily affects' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance has a temporary impact on the function or state of the specified entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effect duration': The subject drug's effect on a specific process lasts for a duration specified by the object entity.
D. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the presence of the substance specified by the object entity.
